title: Declare each operation once for the command line, MCP and the board
notes: One registry (tadu/operations.py) of operations and their arguments generates the argparse subcommands, the MCP tool schemas and the board's calls; MCP and the board run the command itself.
result: tadu/operations.py declares every operation once; build_parser, operation_tools and operation_argv generate the command line, the MCP schemas and the calls the board and MCP run through run_operation
evidence: pytest: 1363 tests at 100% coverage, ruff, mypy --strict and codeality clean; tests/test_operations.py, test_add_operation_parser.py, test_operation_tool*.py, test_operation_argv.py and test_run_operation.py; a before/after snapshot of every argparse action showed only the intended differences
